summary.text: Mary Cavanagh is a Democratic state senator from Michigan who represents District 6 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She served in the Michigan House from 2021 to 2023 and chairs the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mary Cavanagh was born in California and lives in Redford Charter Township, Michigan.
She earned a bachelor's degree in anthropology from Wayne State University in 2020.

Her career experience includes working as the director of project development of New Start Construction, LLC, a program trainer with the Community Opportunity Center, and an administrative assistant with New Horizons Case Management.
Cavanagh represented District 10 in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2021 to 2023 and took office in the state Senate for District 6 on January 1, 2023, succeeding Erika Geiss.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Senate Appropriations, Economic and Small Business Development (as majority vice chair), Finance (as chair), Housing and Human Services, and Labor committees.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Cavanagh said she had served as an AmeriCorps member in Detroit Public Schools before taking office and had been a community activist for 20 years.
